other_side.note: DERIVED, NOT SEPARATELY PRE-REGISTERED. The opposite bet on the same in-sample games (opponent moneyline; under for S30, over for S31), scored with the backtest's own buildRows / summarize / bootRoi (seed 20260929). It comes from the same two-sided test: against no-vig implied %, every row's implied becomes 1 - p and W and L swap, so z changes sign and the two-sided p-value is identical. ROI differs because both sides pay the vig.
